title: Auditing Where Concept Bottleneck Accuracy Comes From on CUB
abstract: arXiv:2610.28059v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) promise predictions that humans can inspect and correct through concepts such as "curved beak". Yet on CUB-200-2011, their standard benchmark, progress is measured like that of ordinary classifiers: by task and concept accuracy. Neither reveals whether the label is predicted from the exposed concept scores, or whether a concept is supported by visual evidence of that concept rather than by co-occurring features such as cues to the species as a whole. We audit where the accuracy of CBMs and Concept Embedding Models (CEMs) on CUB comes from. The CUB annotations are too noisy to explain it: class-level training labels agree with per-image annotations on only ~82% of image--concept pairs, and classifiers trained on per-image annotations reach only ~37% species accuracy. Leakage probes show that CEM predictions cannot be reconstructed from their concept scores; the missing class information sits in internal

translated_title: 审计CUB数据集上概念瓶颈模型准确率的来源
translated_abstract: 概念瓶颈模型承诺提供人类可以通过“弯曲的喙”等概念进行检验和修正的预测。然而在其标准基准CUB-200-2011上，其进展的衡量方式却与普通分类器相同：即通过任务准确率和概念准确率来衡量。这两种指标都无法揭示标签是否确实由暴露的概念分数预测得出，也无法揭示某个概念是由该概念本身的视觉证据所支持，还是由共现特征（例如指向整个物种的线索）所支持。我们审计了CUB上概念瓶颈模型（CBM）和概念嵌入模型（CEM）准确率的来源。CUB的标注噪声太大，无法解释这一现象：类别级训练标签与逐图像标注仅在约82%的图像-概念对上一致，而在逐图像标注上训练的分类器仅能达到约37%的物种准确率。泄漏探针实验表明，CEM的预测无法从其概念分数中重建；缺失的类别信息存在于内部……
tldr: 该研究审计了概念瓶颈模型和概念嵌入模型在CUB基准上准确率的真实来源，发现CUB标注噪声过大、且模型预测依赖内部信息而非暴露的概念分数，从而质疑了现有基于准确率的CBM可解释性评估方式的有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper audits where Concept Bottleneck Models' accuracy on CUB comes from, showing that noisy CUB annotations and internally leaked class information—not the exposed concept scores—make standard accuracy-based evaluations of CBM interpretability unreliable.
